title: Measure the keyed-literal constant export against score.compute (report, do not fix)
body:
## Goal
Measure the one case benchmark/challenges/constant-export-design.md (section `## Limits`, first item) leaves unmeasured: a submission where every required claim answers with the same keyed literal, taken from one real claim, with that claim's citations. Call `score.compute` (score.py:125) in memory on the positive control of library-icon-tests and library-specialty with that mutation; vi-actor-core-native-gap has no claims (NOT-APPLICABLE per the design file). Report, do not fix: no change to score.py, fixtures, results or pins. Also report whether the fixtures already hold any control named like `constant` and whether score.py has a function `regression_self_test` (name and line, or absent). Expected gain: a new file benchmark/challenges/keyed-literal-probe-0185.md with a verdict per fixture (SAFE: no dimension `correct` or `partial`; or UNSAFE: some dimension `correct`/`partial`, with the dimension and score.py lines), so the next shaper can order the control addition and its review. No session can run LabVIEW; claim no LabVIEW behaviour. Benchmark readiness stays false.

## Acceptance
- [ ] write the probe script to `.session/artifacts/keyed_literal_probe.py` and its output to `.session/artifacts/keyed-literal-probe-output.txt` first, before writing the result file
- [ ] the probe runs with `python3 -B` and sets `sys.dont_write_bytecode = True` before importing benchmark/scripts/score.py; it does not call `main()`
- [ ] benchmark/challenges/keyed-literal-probe-0185.md exists with headings `## Measured`, `## Existing controls`, `## Limits`, a verdict word SAFE or UNSAFE per claim-bearing fixture, the score.py lines behind each outcome, and the chosen literal's claim id
- [ ] `git status --porcelain` shows only the new md file; no `__pycache__`, no change to any existing file
- [ ] the verification command below passes; quote its output in `.session/report.md`

## Verification
python3 -B -c "import os;t=open('benchmark/challenges/keyed-literal-probe-0185.md',encoding='utf-8').read();L=t.splitlines();assert all(h in L for h in ('## Measured','## Existing controls','## Limits')),L[:20];assert 'SAFE' in t;assert 'PENDING' not in t;assert not os.path.exists('benchmark/scripts/__pycache__');print('probe OK')"

## Context
This is a fresh start. The first attempt, #800 in iteration 0183, paused when no provider was available. Its branch task/800 no longer exists on origin, so nothing of that attempt can be resumed. Design and earlier verdicts: benchmark/challenges/constant-export-design.md (merged by #797, iteration 0182). Follow the #791 probe that measured empty and non-keyed constant exports, and do not repeat those two probes. Bytecode trap: #785 was refused at merge because of a .pyc file. Long inline python one-liners stalled (#743), so use a script file. Tools can be lost mid-session: save the artifact and the md file early.

## Budget
Read benchmark/challenges/constant-export-design.md whole. In benchmark/scripts/score.py read only `compute` (line 125) and the outcome branches it cites (lines 195-215), plus a Grep for `regression_self_test` and `def `. Grep the two claim-bearing fixtures for claim ids and keys. Do not read whole JSON fixtures or results/challenges.json. Keep command output short and write the report early.
